reasoning.whyChosen: Separate network, resolver and shared DNS ownership.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Single subscription is demonstration scope only.

properties.subnets: Private endpoints in each; separate delegated resolver inbound/outbound hub subnets
properties.dns: Spokes use hub inbound endpoint; hub uses Azure-provided DNS

reasoning.whyChosen: Requested hub/spoke model with explicit DNS query path.
reasoning.tradeoffs: No transitive spoke routing; no firewall, gateway or workload compute.

properties.ruleset: Empty, outbound-associated, hub-linked; no self-forwarding rules

reasoning.whyChosen: Managed hub DNS resolution without VMs.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Inbound and outbound endpoint costs despite empty ruleset.

properties.assignment: Subscription scope; deny opt-in; endpoint policies restricted to networking resource group
properties.identity: User-assigned identity with shared-DNS contributor and scoped custom network remediation role
properties.ownership: Policy owns all dynamic zones, hub links and DNS zone groups

reasoning.whyChosen: Safe missing-group provisioning plus exact-ID audit avoids destroying unrelated group configurations.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Incorrect existing groups require administrator repair. Separate policies do not guarantee sequencing. Live aliases, RBAC, policy acceptance and deployment remain to be verified in Azure.

properties.defaults: Distinct Blob account in spoke1; Key Vault in spoke2
properties.security: No public data access, shared keys disabled, TLS 1.2, Key Vault RBAC and purge protection

reasoning.whyChosen: Separate state keeps test endpoint creation independent of foundation provisioning.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Optional private clients use a third state for two-spoke DNS checks. Key Vault names remain protected after deletion.

resources.name: optional-dns-clients
resources.sku: Standard_B2ats_v2 by default; confirm regional availability and quota

properties.clients: One private Ubuntu Gen2 VM and dedicated subnet per spoke
properties.egress: Two NAT gateways and two Standard public egress IPs, one per VNet
properties.security: No VM public IPs or inbound SSH, SSH public-key provisioning, secure boot and vTPM

reasoning.whyChosen: User approved temporary private clients with Run Command for DNS verification in both spokes.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Run Command requires outbound HTTPS. NAT cannot span VNets; both NAT gateways, VMs, disks and egress public IPs incur additional cost. No resources are deployed by generating scripts.

overallReasoning.summary: Approved new isolated demo; existing landing zone is not inspected, imported, modified or recreated.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: Policy-owned zones are created on demand, so the initial zone resource group is empty. Operators stage zone, link and group remediation. Deny enforcement is explicitly opt-in to avoid accidental subscription-wide impact. No enterprise telemetry, HA/DR, firewall, gateways, CMK or paid DDoS controls in this minimal demo. Live alias query timed out; published aliases and schemas require pre-deployment verification.

plan.validation: Run local init, validate, mocked Terraform plan tests, formatting and security checks. Live plan and acceptance tests require an approved target subscription.
